substantive_conclusions: The project's strongest scientific integration is compositional: models connect through typed interfaces, not by putting every scientific noun in one Lagrangian.

The Potato Axis is presently the cleanest exact project-specific mathematical object; its empirical status depends entirely on predeclared coordinate mappings and predictive comparison with simpler curves.
Door is best treated as a family of threshold operators whose physical instances require dimensionless control variables and observation maps.
UPT becomes more scientifically meaningful when decomposed into coherent descendants rather than defended as one already-finished equation.
Cross-scale mechanism is now a first-class project requirement. Micro-level physics must earn macro-level explanatory relevance through an explicit channel/coarse-graining map.
Measurement, uncertainty and null models are part of the mathematics of the project, not afterthoughts.
A scientific conclusion should state not only what the model illuminates but what result would weaken or eliminate the empirical interpretation.

project_integration_rule: Any future science paper should route its primary equations to the equation ledger, sources to the science source ledger, methodological assumptions to the model-testing protocol, and cross-domain/cross-scale interfaces to the integrated scientific architecture.
